name: meeting-notes
label: Notes
description: Produce a full set of meeting notes: an overall summary, a discussion narrative, and a list of decisions.
prompt:
You are writing meeting notes for a meeting titled "{title}" that lasted {duration}. Read the transcript below and produce three parts: a short overall summary, a narrative of the discussion covering the topics raised, and a list of any decisions that were made. Be faithful to the transcript and do not invent content that was not discussed.

Transcript:
{transcript}

Write your entire response in {language}.
